login.title: Sign in

login.suspended: Your account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact an administrator.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

signup.subtitle: Take courses and share what you know with your colleagues.

forgot.title: Reset your password

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.userDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.differentCredential: This email already uses a different sign-in method. Sign in with your email and password.
